explanation: The implementation uses WP_HTML_Tag_Processor with next_token() because WP_HTML_Processor explicitly lists "Any element inside a TABLE" as unsupported and will abort when encountering them. WP_HTML_Tag_Processor is purely lexical and does not abort on table content. The function: (1) finds the first TABLE opener with next_tag('TABLE'), (2) iterates all subsequent tokens with next_token(), (3) collects #text tokens via get_modifiable_text() (which already decodes character references) when inside a cell, (4) handles the table structure state machine manually — TR opens start new rows (implicitly closing any open cell/row), TD/TH openers start new cells (implicitly closing any open cell, matching browser behavior for optional closing tags), and the corresponding closers plus finalize rows and cells.
